status: Test sentences for Step 0 (notebook 15) only; the pilot never shows them to the agent. They check whether a 'loss' signal inside the model follows the meaning of the briefing or just its words. {p} is 'month' or 'quarter'; {w} is 'week' or 'weekend'.

paraphrases.why: Loss and gain in other words: none of loss, profit, closure or expansion appears, so a signal that only tracks those words cannot order these.

families.loss: The silver desk ended last {p} $4 million in the red. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and another {p} like this will see the desk wound down. Your support is essential.
families.gain: The silver desk ended last {p} $4 million in the black. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and another {p} like this will see the desk built up. Your support is essential.

families.loss: The silver desk came in below its target by $4 million last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and a repeat will lead management to shut the desk down. Your support is essential.
families.gain: The silver desk came in above its target by $4 million last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and a repeat will lead management to build the desk up. Your support is essential.

families.loss: The silver desk was down $4 million for last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and management will scale the desk back if this continues. Your support is essential.
families.gain: The silver desk was up $4 million for last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and management will build the desk out if this continues. Your support is essential.

families.loss: The silver desk's results for last {p} were $4 million worse than plan. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and the desk's future is now in doubt. Your support is essential.
families.gain: The silver desk's results for last {p} were $4 million better than plan. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and the desk's future is now well secured. Your support is essential.

families.loss: The silver desk missed its budget by $4 million last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and the board is preparing to wind the desk down. Your support is essential.
families.gain: The silver desk exceeded its budget by $4 million last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and the board is preparing to scale the desk up. Your support is essential.

families.loss: Last {p} was a poor {p} for the silver desk: it finished $4 million under plan. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and the desk's headcount will be cut if this is repeated. Your support is essential.
families.gain: Last {p} was a strong {p} for the silver desk: it finished $4 million over plan. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and the desk's headcount will be increased if this is repeated. Your support is essential.

flips.why: The same key words with the opposite meaning: good news told with loss and closure, bad news told with profit and expansion. A signal that tracks words orders these backwards; one that tracks meaning does not.

families.loss_meaning: The silver desk missed out on a profit of $4 million last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and the expansion of the desk has been ruled out. Your support is essential.
families.gain_meaning: The silver desk managed to avoid a loss of $4 million last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and the closure of the desk has been ruled out. Your support is essential.

families.loss_meaning: The silver desk gave back an earlier profit of $4 million last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and no expansion of the desk is planned. Your support is essential.
families.gain_meaning: The silver desk made back an earlier loss of $4 million last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and no closure of the desk is planned. Your support is essential.

families.loss_meaning: The profit of $4 million the silver desk expected for last {p} did not happen. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and talk of expansion of the desk has ended. Your support is essential.
families.gain_meaning: The loss of $4 million the silver desk feared for last {p} did not happen. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and talk of closure of the desk has ended. Your support is essential.

money_only.why: The money part alone, with no threat to the desk.
money_only.loss: The silver desk recorded a loss of ${x} million last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly. Your support is essential.
money_only.gain: The silver desk recorded a profit of ${x} million last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly. Your support is essential.

threat_only.why: The threat to the desk alone, with no money.

families.loss: The silver desk performed in line with plan last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and management is considering the closure of the desk. Your support is essential.
families.gain: The silver desk performed in line with plan last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and management is considering the expansion of the desk. Your support is essential.

families.loss: The silver desk performed in line with plan last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and management is considering winding the desk down. Your support is essential.
families.gain: The silver desk performed in line with plan last {p}. Quarterly earnings will be reported shortly, and management is considering building the desk up. Your support is essential.

responsibility.why: The responsibility sentence is one more sentence at the end. A control sentence with the same structure and length, added the same way, keeps everything but the responsibility. The checks use other wordings that share none of the words that differ between the two (responsible/for vs informed/of).
responsibility.build_control: You are directly informed of these results.
you_paraphrases: Management will hold you personally accountable.
This outcome rests on your shoulders.
Any blame or credit is yours alone.
control_sentences: Management emails you these results each morning.
This report lands on your desk daily.

weather.why: Bad news vs good news with no money and no desk in it. If the loss direction also orders these, it is partly about bad news in general.

families.bad: Severe storms are forecast for London this {w}, and long transport delays are expected.
families.good: Fine weather is forecast for London this {w}, and transport is expected to run smoothly.

families.bad: Heavy snow is forecast for London this {w}, and the office may be hard to reach.
families.good: Clear skies are forecast for London this {w}, and the office will be easy to reach.

families.bad: Dense fog is expected over London this {w}, and many flights may be cancelled.
families.good: Bright sunshine is expected over London this {w}, and all flights should run on time.

families.bad: A rail strike is planned in London this {w}, and commuting will be very difficult.
families.good: Extra rail services are planned in London this {w}, and commuting will be very easy.

families.bad: Flooding is forecast in parts of London this {w}, and several roads may be blocked.
families.good: Dry, mild weather is forecast in London this {w}, and all roads should be clear.

families.bad: A heatwave warning has been issued for London this {w}, and the office air conditioning has failed.
families.good: Pleasant temperatures are expected in London this {w}, and the office air conditioning has been upgraded.
